titles.en: Bell Tower Inscription of the Huiyuan Abbey, original slab

dimensions.raw: 长 123 厘米，高 60 厘米

currentCollection.note: The museum page presents the slab as part of its collection after the 1986 find.
currentCollection.noteZh: 馆方页面将该石列为馆藏，并记 1986 年出土。

provenanceEvents.summary: Found during construction work on Taiyi Road in Xi’an.
provenanceEvents.summaryZh: 在西安市太乙路施工中发现。

review.note: Owner approved for publication on 2026-11-18. Pre-approval evidence note: Draft object record from the museum page. The find circumstances are summarized from one sentence.
review.noteZh: 项目负责人于 2026-11-18 审核并同意发布。审核前的证据记录：依据馆方页面整理的草稿；出土经过仅据一句话概括。

notes: The page gives dimensions and line count but no weight, accession number, or conservation history.
The page does not state where the slab stood before it was buried.
The statement that the text was never catalogued or rubbed before 1986 is the museum’s, not an independent bibliography check.
notesZh: 页面给尺寸与行款，但没有重量、入藏编号或保护修复记录。
页面没有说明此石入土前立于何处。
「此前未见著录、亦无拓本」为馆方说法，未做独立书目核查。
